item.tib: dbal phur yang snying rgyud las dus drug srung ma'i bskul pa
item.coloph: dbal phur gsang ba'i yang snying las/ dus drug srungs (srung) ma bskul ba'i le'u/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyis/ 'khros pa khrag gdong dmar po la bshad cing / des bla chen dran pa nam mkha' la rgyud (brgyud) / dran pa'i (pas) phyi rab (rabs) don du gter la sbas/ phyis su kho bo dbra khyung pa g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gsang mtshan stag chung dbal 'bar stag slag can bdag la dngos grub tu babs pa khyung nag rdzong du dge'o// pom ra'i gter ma'o/ mu tsug smar ro//
